name: Flame Blessings
description: God mode, endless health, stamina and mana, and no fall damage, per player and at once. The host switches their own here or on a wheel (F4); admins use /blessings for any player. Each blessing shows on screen and is told in chat; nothing is saved into the world or the character. Host or dedicated server; players who join need nothing. Installed switched off.

settings.help: Endless health refills after each hit, so one very strong hit can still kill you; god mode stops hits.
